stem: What happens next in this passage after “She had found it near the drinking fountain.”?
options: The council knew one week would not solve all waste problems.
Months later, the student saw Mr. Kuo again and thanked him.
Bus driver Mr. Shen knew many students who took his bus.
Mr. Wu thanked her and asked how she knew it was his.
